verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic scale-to-zero after 5s of inactivity with fast resume, which directly supports idle shutdown and implies billing stops when inactive (blaxel-docs-2). However, there is no evidence of a developer-configurable timeout parameter (e.g., custom idle duration) or explicit confirmation that billing halts during scale-to-zero, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of this behavior. Missing for 10: explicit configurable timeout setting, billing-stop confirmation, independent verification.
